user.title: Connect to Miele
user.description: Sign in with the Miele account the app uses. The appliance must be switched on and Mobile Start armed for control.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of the Miele account
data_description.country: Two-letter country code of the account, e.g. NL, DE, GB

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Miele credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The Miele cloud no longer accepts the stored password for {email}. Enter the password of that account again.

error.invalid_auth: The Miele cloud refused the account: check email, password and country

init.title: Choose the washing machine
init.description: Which washing machine of this account gets a measuring plug?

plug.title: Measuring plug
plug.description: The plug that measures {washer}. With a power sensor every wash is measured minute by minute and stored as a power profile. Leave it empty for no plug.

data_description.power_sensor: Power (W) of the plug the washer is connected to
data_description.energy_sensor: Optional energy meter (kWh) of the same plug; when set, the total of a wash comes from it

abort.no_washers: No washing machine was found on this account yet

forget_profile.name: Forget power profile
forget_profile.description: Remove a measured power profile from the matrix, e.g. after a bad measurement.

key.name: Key
key.description: Profile key as shown in the key attribute of the power profile sensor. Empty: the key the power profile sensor shows now.

set_program.name: Set program
set_program.description: Select a washing machine program and optionally its temperature, spin speed, soiling and extras, and start it.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program name (e.g. Cottons) or numeric program id.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Wash temperature in °C. Use 0 for cold. Eco variants are separate values, see the eco field.

eco.name: Eco
eco.description: Use the eco variant of the temperature, when the program offers one.

spin_speed.name: Spin speed
spin_speed.description: Spin speed in rpm. Use 0 for no spin.

soiling.name: Soiling
soiling.description: Soiling level 1-3 of the load. Which levels are offered depends on the program.

extras.name: Extras
extras.description: Extras to switch on; every other extra that can be set from the app is switched off.

detergent.name: Detergent
detergent.description: Switch TwinDos laundry liquid on or off. Off washes without liquid; on restores the last TwinDos choice (Whites or Colours) seen for this washer. Refused unless both TwinDos containers can be changed.

twindos.name: TwinDos
twindos.description: TwinDos laundry liquid: off, whites or colours. Must not contradict detergent. Refused unless both TwinDos containers can be changed.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start the wash after setting it. This cannot be undone from Home Assistant and uses up the armed Mobile Start — re-arm Mobile Start at the machine for the next cycle.

start_at.name: Start at
start_at.description: Arm the washer's own timer for this moment: the washer counts down and starts by itself, also when Home Assistant is offline. Uses up the armed Mobile Start. A moment in the past starts at once.

mobile_start_not_armed.message: Switch the washer on and arm Mobile Start at the machine, then try again
